q: The mutual information between two stationary processes {Xₙ} and {Yₙ} is defined as I(X;Y) = lim_{n→∞} (1/n) I(X₁…Xₙ; Y₁…Yₙ). For an ergodic channel, this equals:
opts: The mutual information rate Ī(X;Y) = H̄(Y) − H̄(Y|X)
exp: The mutual information rate Ī(X;Y) = H̄(Y) − H̄(Y|X) (difference of entropy rates). For channels with memory, the capacity is C = sup_{X stationary} Ī(X;Y), a supremum over stationary input processes. This is the general formula for channels with memory.
